propositions: Plan-review op-certs from a different environment are unconditionally rejected with 'foreign_key' verdict before the trust root is built, even when environment enforcement config keys are unset.
The verify_opcert_record function never consults .rebar/trusted_environments.yaml or verify.require_environment config when principal differs from own_principal.

When environment enforcement is not configured, a cryptographically valid certificate should be accepted regardless of its signing environment, with the trust basis made visible via a new trust_basis field.
The embedded public key within an SSHSIG blob can be extracted and used to verify a signature without tightening enforcement, achieving self-consistency checking for cross-environment attestations.
Documentation currently encodes the future trusted-set restriction as live policy, conflicting with the operator decision that environment should not gate acceptances when enforcement is disabled.
